onset_text: Symptoms began early during rapid ascent at an unspecified altitude. The aircrew member signaled distress at 18,000 ft.
clinical_diagnosis: Pulmonary barotrauma with cerebral arterial gas embolism, as diagnosed by the report authors.
imaging: Left upper-lobe cyst with an air-fluid level on chest imaging. Brain CT normal. No pneumothorax or pneumomediastinum.
locator: Primary report pp. 172–173, A profile, Case Report and outcomes (PDF pp. 1–2)
